blocks.text: Five years since Yllana Aduana’s coronation as Miss FIT (Face, Intelligence, Tone) Philippines, another Laguna bet clinched the crown, Kailey Rose Kemp from the City of Santa Rosa. The new queen bested 20 other aspirants at the competition held at the SM Skydome in Quezon City on Tuesday evening, Oct. 27, to inherit the crown from last year’s winner, Maria Katrina Calica. Miss FIT Philippines is an annual beauty pageant that promotes holistic fitness. Aduana won the crown in 2021, two years before she earned the Miss Philippines Earth title in 2023.
